title: Dunford-Pettis Multilinear Operators and their variations: A revisit to the classic concepts of Operator Ideals
summary: In this paper, we will address broader concepts for Dunford-Pettis operators, presenting new classes and results that correlate this class with others already well-studied in the literature, as well as an approach outside the origin. We also investigate the inclusion results and conditions for the coincidence of this class with others previously studied and also with new classes that will emerge throughout this text.
